detailed_description: YouTube Description Generator turns a video title, comma-separated keywords, channel name, and optional CTA link into a structured YouTube video description draft. The real component creates a hook, learning bullets, related keyword section, subscribe/follow block, hashtag-style keyword line, character count, and first-157-character preview. It does not upload or edit videos, fetch channel data, validate links, schedule publishing, or guarantee views.
usage_steps: Add comma-separated keywords and the channel name.
Review the hook, learning bullets, related keywords, subscribe block, character count, and first-157-character preview.
Copy the description, replace generic bullets with real video details, and paste the edited version into YouTube Studio manually.
usage_examples: Create a repeatable description format for tutorials or educational videos.
Add topic keywords as a related keyword section and hashtag-style line.
Preview the first characters that may appear before the viewer expands the description.

faqs.question: Is YouTube Description Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. YouTube Description Generator runs free in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does it upload or edit my YouTube video?
faqs.answer: No. It only creates description text. Uploading, editing, and publishing still happen in YouTube Studio.

faqs.question: What does the first 157 characters preview show?
faqs.answer: It shows the beginning of the generated description so you can review the part that may appear before viewers expand the description.

faqs.question: What should I review before publishing?
faqs.answer: Check that the description matches the actual video, links are correct, keywords are relevant, and claims are accurate.
